definitions.joined: The subject entity became a member of or started working for the organization specified by the object entity.
definitions.left: The subject entity ceased to be a member of or stopped working for the organization specified by the object entity.

definitions.developed: The subject entity created or developed the product, system, or technology specified by the object entity.
definitions.expanded: The subject entity expanded the scope, size, or capabilities of the entity specified by the object entity.
definitions.operates: The subject entity operates or manages the facility, organization, or entity specified by the object entity.
definitions.works on: The subject entity works on or focuses research/development efforts on the topic specified by the object entity.

definitions.is: The subject entity is identified as or equated to the object entity.
definitions.is birthplace of: The subject entity is the location where the person or entity specified by the object entity was born.
definitions.was born in: The subject entity was born in the location specified by the object entity.
